title: P.8 Transformations of Functions

icans: I can describe vertical and horizontal shifts.
I can describe stretches and shrinks and write a transformed function.

vocab: a shift or _____________: the graph changes position but not shape
a __________ or shrink: the graph changes shape

blocks.p: Graph y = a|x − h| + k with sliders. Move one at a time.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Shifts: y = f(x) + c moves up c; y = f(x − c) moves _______________ c.

blocks.stem: Describe g(x) = (x + 2)² − 3 compared with f(x) = x².

notes: Reflections: y = −f(x) reflects in the x-axis; y = f(−x) reflects in the _______________.

blocks.stem:
Describe each compared with f(x) = √x.
a.  g(x) = −√x
b.  h(x) = √(−x)
c.  k(x) = −√(x + 2)

notes: Stretches and shrinks: y = cf(x) is a vertical stretch (c > 1) or shrink (0 < c < 1); y = f(cx) is a _______________ shrink when c > 1.

blocks.stem:
Describe each compared with the parent.
a.  g(x) = 3|x|
b.  h(x) = (1/3)|x|
c.  k(x) = (2x)²
Write the function: y = x³ shifted right 4, reflected in the x-axis, and shifted up 2.
Describe g(x) = −2(x + 1)² + 5 compared with f(x) = x², and give its vertex.
Write the function: y = |x| reflected in the x-axis, shifted left 2 and down 4.

tickets.stem: Which way does y = (x − 5)² move from y = x²?
Describe y = −x³ compared with y = x³.
